notes: Read the full 133-line numbered source before editing; every line was considered. Imports L1-8 covered: L1 useMemo (react) -> kept (+useEffect/useRef/useState/ReactNode for the inlined shell); L2 useTranslation('dashboard') (react-i18next) -> native useNativeTranslation() t(key,fallback)=fallback??key preserving every key + English default; L3 lucide Activity -> escaped-unicode glyph stand-in ICON_ACTIVITY '💓' tinted colors.success (text-neon-green), reused at 20px muted for the empty-state icon; L4 Badge (@/components/ui) -> native inline <Badge> with the dark-theme variant colours the web Tailwind classes resolve to; L5 EmptyState (@/components/feedback) -> native inline <EmptyState>; L6 useSystemHealth (@/api/hooks/useAdmin) -> already-ported web-parity hook (../../../api/hooks/useAdmin); L7 WidgetShell (./WidgetShell) -> native inline WidgetShell incl. the `actions` slot; L8 WidgetProps type (./types) -> local WidgetSize{cols,rows}+WidgetProps mirror.

Covered SERVICE_KEYS (web L10): ['database','mqtt','tesla_api','fleet_telemetry'] as const reproduced verbatim. Covered ServiceStatus (web L12) 'ok'|'healthy'|'degraded'|'unhealthy'. Covered statusVariant (web L14-18) 1:1 branch order: ok/healthy -> 'success'; degraded -> 'warning'; else 'danger' (web return type 'success'|'warning'|'danger' kept as BadgeVariant).

Covered StatusDot (web L20-29): web <span h-2.5 w-2.5 rounded-full shadow-[0_0_6px] {bg-green-500|bg-amber-400|bg-red-500}> -> native <View> 10x10 borderRadius 999 with dynamic backgroundColor + matching shadowColor (DOT_GREEN #22c55e / DOT_AMBER #fbbf24 / DOT_RED #ef4444) and a 6px/0.4-opacity glow (shadow-{color}/40). Same ok/healthy -> green, degraded -> amber, else red branch order.

Covered ServiceRow (web L31-43): web flex items-center justify-between; left flex items-center gap-2 (StatusDot + span text-xs text-[var(--text-secondary)] label); right <Badge variant={statusVariant(status)} className='text-[10px]'>{ok/healthy?'OK':status}</Badge>. Native row spaceBetween: serviceLeft (dot + 12px textSecondary label, flexShrink to truncate) + <Badge tiny> (text-[10px] -> badgeTextTiny 10px). OK/status label logic preserved verbatim.

Covered the main widget (web L45-67): UptimeMonitorWidget({size}) (vehicleId unused in source, omitted from the destructure but kept in WidgetProps); useTranslation('dashboard')->useNativeTranslation (L46); useSystemHealth() destructuring data/isLoading/error/isFetching/isStale/isError/dataUpdatedAt/refetch (L47); isCompact = size.cols===1 && size.rows===1 (L49); isTall = size.rows>=2 (L50); services useMemo (L52-61): components=data?.components??{}; SERVICE_KEYS.map(key=>({key, label:t(`widget.uptime.${key}`, key.replace(/_/g,' ').replace(/\b\w/g,c=>c.toUpperCase())), status:(components[key]?.status??'unhealthy') as ServiceStatus, failures:components[key]?.consecutiveFailures??0, lastError:components[key]?.lastError??null})) with deps [data,t] — the computed i18n default + all nullish fallbacks + the unused-but-mapped failures/lastError fields preserved 1:1; overallStatus=data?.status??'unknown' (L63); healthyCount=services.filter(s=>s.status==='ok'||s.status==='healthy').length (L64-66).

Covered the render (web L68-132): <WidgetShell title={isCompact?undefined:t('widget.uptime.title','Uptime Monitor')} icon=Activity glyph (text-neon-green->colors.success) loading=isLoading error={error?String(error):null} updatedAt=dataUpdatedAt isFetching isStale isError onRefresh=()=>refetch()>. data ? <View flex flex-col gap-2 h-full>: overallRow (uppercase text-[10px] muted 'Overall' label + <Badge variant={statusVariant(overallStatus as ServiceStatus)}>{overallStatus==='healthy'?t('widget.uptime.allOk','All OK'):overallStatus}</Badge>); then isCompact ? bigNumber (flex-1 center, text-2xl/24px bold textPrimary {healthyCount}/{services.length}) : serviceList (column gap-2, one <ServiceRow> per service keyed by svc.key); then isTall && !isCompact ? tallDetail (mt-auto pt-2 border-t border-white/[0.06]: DB Size/data.databaseSize and Tables/data.tableCount rows, text-[10px] muted label + secondary value, nullish->em-dash) : null. Else branch: <EmptyState icon=Activity 20px glyph message=t('widget.uptime.noData','No system health data')> (the web no-action transient empty state). export default + displayName retained.

Native WidgetShell reproduces the web shell: loading skeleton (Skeleton h-full rounded-xl -> surfaceRaised rounded 16, minHeight 120), error body (QueryError -> danger AppText), the 1500ms green pulse-on-update effect (prevUpdatedAt ref + setTimeout, shadow rgba(34,197,94,0.15)), the inline DataFreshness chip (fresh/fetching/stale/error glyph ●/↻/●/✕ + relative time just now/m/h/d/w ago, tap-to-refresh Pressable, dot-only compact when title-less per web L91), and BOTH header branches — title branch renders icon+title left / freshness+actions right (web flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-3 pb-1, h3 text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider muted); title-less branch (compact 1x1) renders an absolute freshness overlay (web absolute top-1.5 right-1.5 z-5) + an optional right-aligned actions row. The uptime widget passes no actions, but the slot is kept for shell fidelity. Native EmptyState mirrors web @/components/feedback EmptyState (centred icon + muted message, web py-4 -> paddingVertical 16).

Tailwind/DOM -> React Native: div/span -> View/AppText; flex/gap-2 -> flexDirection+rowGap/columnGap spacing.sm; justify-between -> justifyContent space-between; h-2.5 w-2.5 -> 10x10; shadow-[0_0_6px] {color}/40 -> shadowColor/shadowRadius 6/shadowOpacity 0.4/elevation; rounded-full -> borderRadius 999; h-3.5 w-3.5 lucide -> 13px glyph; h-5 w-5 empty icon -> 20px glyph; text-2xl -> 24px; text-xs -> 12px; text-[10px] -> 10px; text-[11px] uppercase tracking-wider -> 11px letterSpacing 0.8 textTransform uppercase; text-[var(--text-primary|secondary|muted)] -> colors.textPrimary/textSecondary/textMuted; text-neon-green -> colors.success; border-white/[0.06] -> rgba(255,255,255,0.06); Badge dark-theme variants success bg-green-900 #14532d/text-green-200 #bbf7d0, warning bg-yellow-900 #713f12/text-yellow-200 #fef08a, danger bg-red-900 #7f1d1d/text-red-200 #fecaca; mt-auto -> marginTop 'auto'. No DOM-only modules, browser HTML elements, Recharts, Leaflet, or old web UI components imported — imports limited to react, react-native (Pressable/StyleSheet/View), the native AppText + theme tokens, and the already-ported web-parity useSystemHealth hook. Styles alphabetised (keys + properties) per react-native/sort-styles. Gates run from apps/native: npm run typecheck; npm run lint -- --quiet; npm test -- --runInBand --detectOpenHandles.
